question: In March 2025, who among the following won the Prague Masters (Masters section) 2025 chess title?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravindh Chithambaram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian Grandmaster **Aravindh Chithambaram** emerged as the champion of the **Prague Masters (Masters section) 2025**.
 
• The prestigious chess tournament was held in **Prague**, **Czech Republic**, and concluded in **March 2025**.
 
• **Aravindh Chithambaram** secured the title by delivering a stellar performance against a field of elite international **Grandmasters** in a **round-robin** format.
 
• This victory marks a significant milestone in his career, further establishing his presence in the upper echelons of global chess and boosting his **FIDE rating**.
